name: Chicken biryani
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt with garam masala and turmeric for a few minutes.
Fry the sliced onion in ghee until deep golden and soft.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the marinated chicken and cook until browned through.
Fold through the cooked rice with a splash of water, cover, and steam on low for ten minutes.
Rest off the heat, then fluff and serve.
